buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) . Scope of Work The scope of work includes the design, supply, printing, and installation of identi fication stickers/labels on utility and chemical pipelines in the SRM, NCT, SC and VAP sections of the plant, as per the specifications and approximate quantities/l engths mentioned in the tender document. The work shall include identification of pipeline contents, flow direction arrows and chemical hazard/warning labels, wherever applicable, in accordance with th e approved specifications and applicable GMP/SOP and safety requirements. 2. Experience of Similar Work The bidder should have experience in the supply and installation of industrial si gnboards, safety signage, identification labels, pipeline identification stickers or similar signage/labeling work in industrial, manufacturing, chemical, pharmace utical or other institutional premises. The bidder shall submit copies of relevant work orders and/or completion certifi cates as proof of experience, wherever available. 3. Technical Capability The bidder shall possess the necessary facilities and capability for printing, supp lying and installing durable identification stickers/labels suitable for industrial ut ility and chemical pipelines. The bidder shall ensure that the labels are clearly le gible, properly affixed and suitable for the intended operating environment.

4. Material and Quality Requirements The stickers/labels shall be durable, moisture-resistant, chemical-resistant, easy to clean and resistant to peeling, fading and deterioration under the applicable site conditions. The text, dimensions, colours, flow direction arrows and hazard warnings shall be as per the specifications approved by the department. 5. Site Visit and Measurement The bidder shall assess the site conditions, accessibility and installation require ments before quoting, wherever required. The department may facilitate a site visit with prior permission. The bidder shall verify the actual locations and installation requirements before commencing the work. 6. Approval of Design and Sample The successful bidder shall submit sample stickers/labels and the proposed desi gn, colour scheme, text and layout for approval by the department before bulk printing and installation. Bulk printing and installation shall commence only afte r approval. 7. Installation and Workmanship The bidder shall supply and install the stickers/labels at suitable and clearly visi ble locations, including near valves, junctions, branches, wall penetrations and changes in pipeline direction, as applicable. Flow direction arrows shall be provi ded and repeated wherever necessary. The work shall be carried out without damaging the existing pipelines, insulation, equipment or plant facilities. Any additional work shall be undertake n only with prior approval of the department. 8. Safety Requirements The bidder shall comply with the applicable plant safety rules and instructions d uring execution. The bidder shall ensure that its personnel use appropriate pers onal protective equipment (PPE). Work on operating pipelines or in restricted ar eas shall be undertaken only with the necessary permission from the authorized plant officials. 9. Labour, Tools and Consumables The bidder shall arrange the required manpower, tools, equipment, consumable s and installation accessories at its own cost. The quoted rates shall include all c osts associated with supply, printing, transportation, installation and completion of the work, unless otherwise specified in the tender. 10. Inspection and Acceptance The completed work shall be inspected by the authorized departmental represe ntative. Payment shall be processed after satisfactory completion, verification a nd acceptance of the work, in accordance with the applicable GeM contract ter ms. 11. Replacement of Defective Labels Any sticker/label found defective, illegible, improperly installed or not conformin

g to the approved specifications at the time of inspection shall be rectified or re placed by the bidder at no additional cost to the department. 12. Completion Period The successful bidder shall complete the work within the period specified in the GeM contract or as stipulated by the department in the tender, subject to applic able contractual provisions. 13. Documents to be submitted The bidder shall submit the following documents, as applicable: a. GST registration details and PAN. b. Relevant work orders and/or completion certificates for similar work. c. Technical details of the proposed stickers/labels, including material, printing method and durability. d. Acceptance of the scope of work and applicable technical specifications. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
